source_basis: usually deemed perceptual and subjective. However, it can be quantified
interpretation: Sets up a contrast between taste and measurement, then takes the second side.

source_basis: the measurement is given by the combination of three indicators: 1, 2, 3
interpretation: A score announced as a numbered list before any of it is derived.
counterevidence: Numbering three items is slightly stiff.

source_basis: in order to analyze the influence in a clear and systematic way, we restate
interpretation: The restatement is given a purpose.

source_basis: the rest of the paper is structured as follows
interpretation: A section map. Rare and useful in contest papers.

source_basis: we are motivated to use a modified framework instead
interpretation: The method choice is given a motive: keeping interactions the usual tool drops.

source_basis: Empirically, we assume that revolutionary artists have great impact while receiving small influence
interpretation: An assumption tagged as coming from experience.

source_basis: since it is not objective to observe the series by the curve shapes
interpretation: A transform justified by refusing to judge by eye.
counterevidence: The replacement has its own judgments.

source_basis: Definition. For an edge directed from influencer to follower
interpretation: A labeled definition, the register of a textbook.

source_basis: 11 out of 37, about 0.2973. It should be noted that the value stays the same
interpretation: One real fraction, then the scope of the result.

source_basis: the thicker the edge, the larger its weight
interpretation: A visual encoding stated as a proportion.

source_basis: readers could refer to more details in the reference
interpretation: Sends the reader to the source instead of pretending to re-derive it.

source_basis: meaning that our proposed model of central nodes is valid
interpretation: A predicted shift happens, and the sentence says so plainly.
counterevidence: Valid is a big word for one genre.

source_basis: Influence as a product of a decade share, a genre share and out-degree
interpretation: Three factors, one operation, no learned weights.

source_basis: Similarity as the expected value over random three-feature embeddings
interpretation: An ensemble instead of one projection, to keep interactions.

source_basis: Bayes error rate between two similarity distributions, 0.486 and 0.916
interpretation: Separability measured by the best possible error.
counterevidence: The direction of the reading needs care.

source_basis: Revolutionary equals large out-closeness minus in-closeness
interpretation: A definition turned into a centrality gap.
counterevidence: The combination rule is not shown.

source_basis: The data's own influence labels tested by similarity
interpretation: Reported links are not trusted; they are checked.
counterevidence: The check shares features with the labels.

source_basis: A definition confirmed by the shift it predicts
interpretation: Prediction before observation.

source_basis: Two Bayes error rates reported with the figures
interpretation: A number and a picture for the same claim.

source_basis: A Kruskal-Wallis p-value watched as each feature is removed
interpretation: Importance read from the movement of a test.

source_basis: The non-musical count field dropped, leaving thirteen traits
interpretation: A field excluded for being irrelevant, with the reason.

source_basis: Embedding dimension 3 taken from a cited experiment
interpretation: A parameter borrowed and attributed.
counterevidence: The experiment was on different data.

source_basis: Three short assumptions, one of them the definition of the target
interpretation: The assumption is doing definitional work.

source_basis: Low frequency is taken to mean the real trend
interpretation: A reading of the spectrum treated as given.
counterevidence: High frequency can carry real change.

source_basis: Bob Dylan and the Beatles are the two largest nodes
interpretation: A graph summary a reader can check.
counterevidence: Size encodes out-degree, not the weighted score.

source_basis: Energy, valence and speechiness distinguish genres; acousticness, danceability and valence spread
interpretation: Two different jobs for the traits, kept apart.

source_basis: Mean similarity falls from 0.85 to 0.45 when measured from the center
interpretation: A predicted drop with both numbers.

source_basis: Node size for out-degree, color for genre, thickness for weight
interpretation: Three encodings, all stated.

source_basis: Heatmaps of the decade and genre indicators
interpretation: The two factors shown before they are multiplied.

source_basis: Overlaid distributions with Gaussian fits
interpretation: Raw and fitted together.

source_basis: The letter is set in columns, like a brochure
interpretation: A designed page instead of prose. Unusual and risky.
applicability: Only if the content survives without the layout.

source_basis: The weak step named precisely: collapsing a distribution to one number
interpretation: A limitation aimed at a single operation.
